title: Cloud City: Data Protection: Cloud KMS, Sensitive Data Protection & Encryption

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Tax records and patient health files were written in plain ink on parchment, readable by any courier walking down the hallway.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Archivist Arthur introduced cipher seals (Cloud KMS) and redacting ink stamps (Cloud DLP) to mask sensitive citizen identities.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When a courier dropped a tax ledger in the street, onlookers could only see redacted black bars and scrambled cipher tokens.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Parchment redaction requires physical ink and shears; digital DLP transforms millions of rows in seconds using regex and machine learning.
